items.title_en: Flood Facts From Four Ferocious Floods: Part Two
items.title_zh: 四次猛烈洪水的洪水事实：第二部分
items.summary_en: Ferocious floods cannot really be stopped and that’s what makes them so scary. If you haven’t read Flood Facts From Four Ferocious Floods: Part One, follow the link, because this is part two. Venezuela Coast Continued… Out of the 30,000 people who died, only 1000 bodies were ever found. The rest disappeared into the water.
items.summary_zh: 凶猛的洪水无法真正被阻止，这就是它们如此可怕的原因。如果您还没有阅读《四次凶猛洪水的洪水事实：第一部分》，请点击链接，因为这是第二部分。委内瑞拉海岸继续……在 30,000 名死者中，仅发现了 1000 具尸体。其余的都消失在水中。
